claude.performance_metric: SEC registration terminated (Form 15 filed Dec 10, 2018); acquired business thereafter reported only within acquirer's combined, undifferentiated portfolio — no standalone realized outcome scalar
claude.rationale: The slice documents only public-reporting status: LaSalle terminated its SEC registration at closing and the acquired business was folded into Pebblebrook's combined hotel portfolio with no separate segment or narrative disclosure in the FY2021/FY2022 10-Ks. Because no standalone realized-performance record exists for the acquired business, there is no documented evidence of disruption at the product/process interface (p4) or fracture at the process/organization interface (p5); both are set to uncertain rather than 0 because the absence of disclosure prevents determining whether such disruption occurred. The press-reported post-closing dispositions are explicitly marked [UNVERIFIED] and not attributed to the LaSalle business, so they cannot ground any pathway coding.
